title: can i stop the bot to responding in another channel
answer:
Yea sure follow the steps given below
1. `!texttoggle`

Execute this command in any channel where you wish to disable LunaBot’s responses.

This must be applied individually in every channel you want excluded.

2. `!setup` (!setup #channel) 

A more efficient alternative to `!texttoggle`.

Requires execution only once.

Automatically creates a dedicated function channel for LunaBot commands.

3. Compatibility Note

If you are using `!togglemessage`, the `!setup` command will remain fully functional in conjunction with it.

title: how can i change the bot prefix
answer:
The default prefix for the bot is ``!``, while for the Prime bot it is ``-``.  
To check the prefix used in your server, you can mention the bot. To change the prefix, use the command ``!prefix``.

**Example:**  
- To change the standard bot prefix:  
  ``!prefix %``  
  or  
  ``@LunaBot 🌙#9997prefix``  

- To change the Prime bot prefix:  
  ``-prefix %``  
  or  
  ``@LunaBot Prime 🌙#0940prefix``

answer:

@Jim The Cow (01/03/2026 12:17 PM, edited 08/17/2026 2:40 PM)
LunaBot Premium Subscribers are eligible for a refund if they meet the requirements mentioned in the link below:
[Patreon Refund Policy EN](https://support.patreon.com/hc/en-us/articles/205032045-Patreon-s-refund-policy)
The above link mentions who is eligible for a refund, and who isn’t. 
__Eligible Refunds include:__
“Subscriber forgets to cancel membership.” - They are eligible for a full refund for **one** specific payment cycle.
“LunaBot stops offering Premium Subscriptions and the Subscriber’s already-in-use Subscription stops working.” - They are eligible for a full refund for **one or more** specific payment cycles, depending on when the service stopped.
“Subscriber has valid proof of LunaBot’s Premium Subscriptions violating existing or new policies regarding harassment and abuse.” - Amount of payment cycles being refunded **varies**.
“Subscriber gets blacklisted before using their Subscription.” - They are eligible for **one** specific payment cycle, **unless their blacklist gets removed quickly after.** 
“Subscriber has already cancelled their automatic renewal but their account gets charged.” - They are eligible for **one** specific payment cycle **if they include a receipt of their bank’s transaction.**
“Subscriber has cancelled their membership within **2 hours** of their last renewal/subscription.” - They are eligible for **one** specific payment cycle.
“Subscriber pays for the Subscription while thinking they’re using a currency different than the one listed on the website.” - They are eligible for **one or more** specific payment cycles, depending on their first payment cycle if still occurring, **only if their currency is not listed in the Pre-Billing and Billing phases of the website.**
“LunaBot suddenly stops producing and the Subscriber still has an active Subscription.” - They are eligible for **one or more** specific payment cycles, depending on when the service stopped producing.

**If you think that the Subscriber is eligible for one, you may ping a Community Manager or Admin.**

 __Ineligible Refunds include:__
“Subscriber’s LunaBot Premium Bot stops working due to a temporary outage or downtime.” - Our [Terms of Service](https://lunabot.vc/terms-of-service/) mention that we reserve the right to suspend or terminate someone’s access to the service at any time, without prior notice, for any reason whatsoever.
“Subscriber’s remorse. This includes accidental purchases, change of mind and other excuses, **unless they meet at least one requirement from the above list.** 
“Subscribers who claim to have purchased a Premium Subscription outside Patreon or on a website that pretends to be Patreon.” - Premium Subscriptions can only be purchased through Patreon; if this changes in the future, the message will be edited.
“Subscriber’s Transactions which have already been refunded or chargedback by their or the Owner’s Bank.” - If someone attempts to request a refund after having received one from their or the Owner’s bank, we have the right to blacklist them.

**If you are unsure whether a Subscriber is eligible for a refund or not, please mention a Moderator or higher. Useful links towards the Subscriber can be found below:**
[Patreon’s Refund Policy (EN)](https://support.patreon.com/hc/en-us/articles/205032045-Patreon-s-refund-policy)
[Refund Policy through lunabot.vc](https://lunabot.vc/refund_returns-2/)
